markup.content: افتح اللعبة في متصفح يدعم JavaScript.

style.content: *{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#10171d;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif}main{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center}.stage{position:relative;width:min(100%,225vh);height:100%;max-height:65vw;overflow:hidden;background:#25303c;isolation:isolate}canvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}.hud,.touch{position:absolute;left:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-left));right:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-right));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;direction:ltr}.hud{top:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top));pointer-events:none}.bar,.pair{display:flex;gap:8px}.bar{pointer-events:auto}button,.meter{color:#fff;background:#102029ba;border:1px solid #ffffff50;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0002;font:700 19px system-ui;cursor:pointer}.meter{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:11px 12px;align-items:center}.meter i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff45}.meter i.on{background:#ffc46c;box-shadow:0 0 8px #ffcb82}button{width:42px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0}.touch{bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));pointer-events:none}.touch button{pointer-events:auto;width:clamp(56px,8vw,82px);height:clamp(46px,8vh,62px);font-size:29px;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}.touch .jump{background:#fbd29b;color:#1d282e}.down,button:active{transform:scale(.94)}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe4a6}.panel{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#09151fbf;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;z-index:5}.dialog{padding:18px;min-width:200px;border-radius:15px;background:#15252d;border:1px solid #ffe5b36b}.dialog p{margin:6px}.dialog button{margin:8px auto;width:auto;padding:0 16px;color:#16242a;background:#ffcf8f}.panel[hidden],[hidden]{display:none!important}.map{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px}.map button{width:32px;height:32px}.map button:disabled{opacity:.35}.sel{outline:1px solid #ead0a4}#boot{position:absolute;top:30%;left:5%;right:5%;text-align:center;background:#102029;color:#fff}@media(orientation:portrait){.stage{max-height:100%;height:100%}.touch{bottom:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.touch button{height:62px;width:66px}}@media(max-height:400px){.hud button{height:31px}.touch{bottom:5px}.touch button{height:40px}}
